adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` the new fallback logic for `selectedCalendar` in `updateEvent` is:

```ts
const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId
  ? externalCalendarId
  : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;
```

When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the else-branch), it searches for a destination calendar whose `externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., `undefined`/`null`), which cannot match a real calendar externalId, so it will return `undefined`. This drops the prior behavior of falling back to the event’s destination calendar externalId. The same dead lookup pattern is also used in `deleteEvent` for `calendarId`.

This is a verifiable correctness defect in the diff: the fallback branch can never successfully select a real calendar and will cause updates/deletes to target an undefined calendar id path instead of the intended destination calendar.
